notes: SZNEO = Shenzhen NEO Electronic Co., Ltd (szneo.com), a budget consumer IP-camera maker. Its official website has no support/download/FAQ/KB section and publishes NO user manual, datasheet, or CGI/API guide that specifies a fixed RTSP URL, stream path, or port. SZNEO cameras are marketed as ONVIF-compatible and are configured via the vendor mobile app / ONVIF auto-discovery rather than a documented static RTSP URL. Every candidate path for this brand originates ONLY from third-party aggregators (iSpyConnect/Agent DVR, camlytics, geniusvision), and those lists are heavily cross-brand contaminated (Dahua /cam/realmonitor, generic ipcam.sdp / ch0_0.h264 / onvif-h264). Per the CC0 no-guessing rule, no template is published. To integrate, use ONVIF discovery or the vendor app.
